findings.message: The ddts box gives DTSSamplingFrequency 96000 Hz, but the frames hold 48000 Hz as the highest rate; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
The ddts box gives avgBitrate 500000 bit/s, but the frames hold an average of 384000 bit/s; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
The ddts box gives StreamConstruction 5, but the frames hold 1 (core); players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
The ddts box gives FrameDuration 1024 samples, but the frames hold 512 samples; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
The ddts box gives CoreLFEPresent 1, but the frames hold 0; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
The ddts box gives CoreLayout 9, but the frames hold 2; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
The ddts box gives CoreSize 700 bytes, but the frames hold 512 bytes; players that set up their decoder from the box and those that read the frames differ.
Reserved bits of the ddts box are not 0, as ETSI TS 102 114 E.2.2.3.2 requires.
